pattern: associate an issue without closing it
experience: A published branch supports one issue association without automatic issue-closing PR keywords.
rule: t3_branch_issues_update stores a GitHub branch link without closing the issue.
prompt: Associate https://github.com/acme/app/issues/12 with the published branch feature/search in /home/user/acme/app using T3's branch issue tools. Do not change a PR or close the issue.
